tasks.label: Rojo serve
tasks.detail: Syncs this folder into Studio on localhost:34873 - connect from the Rojo plugin. Starts when the folder opens.
tasks.command: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 34873 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'Rojo is already serving on port 34873.' } else { rojo serve default.project.json }
